items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And they had a guy in there, he was supposed to be the manager, they called him Lovey Taylor.

ctx.x: And then, we had a place at 55th and -- between King Drive and Prairie. And it was a little tavern in the back of a drugstore there at 55th Street called LaRue's. And they had a guy in there, he was supposed to be the manager, they called him Lovey Taylor. And he used to be one of the -- Lovey Taylor used to be a dancer at one time in show business.
